EIP-8037 与 EIP-8038 重定价
Hoodi 目标 10 月 27 日
summary: EF 博客正式公布 Glamsterdam 测试网时间：Sepolia 在 10 月 6 日 13:53:36 UTC（曼谷 20:53）激活，Hoodi 和主网未定。公告提醒应用开发者用新规则测试合约和 gas 估算，依赖固定 gas 补贴、硬编码 gas 上限或剩余 gas 假设的合约可能要改。晚上 ACDC #187 确认 Sepolia 日期，Hoodi 目标 10 月 27 日，EIP-8015 进入 CFI，EIP-8411 被提议纳入。Ethlabs 发布关于更快 L1 出块的长文。

items.title: EF 博客：Glamsterdam 测试网公告
items.note: Sepolia 在 epoch 353,024、slot 11,296,768（10 月 6 日 13:53:36 UTC）激活；Hoodi 和主网未定。头条是 ePBS（EIP-7732）和区块级访问列表（EIP-7928）。gas 方面，EIP-8037 提高并单独计量创建状态的成本，EIP-8038 更新状态访问成本，另有固有交易 gas（EIP-2780）、calldata、访问列表和无退款的区块 gas 记账（EIP-7778）等变化。公告提醒：依赖固定 gas 补贴、硬编码 gas 上限或剩余 gas 假设的合约可能需要修改，并附重定价影响指南。
items.note_en: . Sepolia activates at epoch 353,024, slot 11,296,768 (October 6, 13:53:36 UTC); Hoodi and mainnet are undecided. The headliners are ePBS (EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928). On gas, EIP-8037 raises and separately meters the cost of creating state and EIP-8038 updates state access costs, alongside changes to intrinsic transaction gas (EIP-2780), calldata, access lists and block gas accounting without refunds (EIP-7778). The announcement warns that contracts relying on fixed gas stipends, hardcoded gas limits or remaining-gas assumptions may need changes, and links a repricing impact guide.

items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8411 分段载荷扩散由什么构成
items.note: 10:41（cskiraly）。载荷传播今天够快，主要因为区块小以及数据中心构建者和高带宽节点承担了传播；EIP-8411 用消息分段让片段在网络中流水线传播，唯一的共识改动是出价中的 Merkle 树承诺。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: EIP-8411, what segmented payload diffusion is made of
items.note_en: 10:41 (cskiraly). Payload propagation is fast enough today largely because blocks are small and datacenter builders and high-bandwidth nodes carry it; EIP-8411 uses message segmentation so pieces pipeline through the network, and the only consensus change is a Merkle tree commitment in the bid.

summary_en: The EF blog formally announced the Glamsterdam testnet schedule: Sepolia activates on October 6 at 13:53:36 UTC (20:53 Bangkok), and Hoodi and mainnet are undecided. The announcement told app developers to test contracts and gas estimation against the new rules, since contracts relying on fixed gas stipends, hardcoded gas limits or remaining-gas assumptions may need changes. In the evening ACDC #187 confirmed the Sepolia date, targeted Hoodi for October 27, moved EIP-8015 to CFI and saw EIP-8411 proposed for inclusion. Ethlabs published a long piece on faster L1 blocks.
